notes: SCLS246T (Oct 1995, rev Oct 2023), 42pp, SN54AHCT14/SN74AHCT14 hex Schmitt-trigger inverters. Banked for U-RX-MOD, the module's SPI receiver (hardware/module/digital-and-supervision): VT+ 0.9-1.9 V at 4.5 V and 1.0-2.1 V at 5.5 V, VT- 0.5-1.5 V and 0.6-1.7 V, hysteresis 0.4 V min (p.5); input clamp current specified for VI < 0 only and II +/-1 uA at VCC = 0 V (pp.4-5): no clamp to VCC; tpd 1-9 ns (p.6); Ci 10 pF max (p.5).
